title.zh: 将邦板牙省 Guagua市镇 Guagua 区医院的名称变更为邦板牙省立医院的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Guagua District Hospital in the Municipality of Guagua, Province of Pampanga, to Pampanga Provincial Hospital
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Guagua District Hospital in the Municipality of Guagua, Province of Pampanga, to Pampanga Provincial Hospital
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Bệnh viện huyện Guagua tại Thị trấn Guagua, Tỉnh Pampanga thành Bệnh viện tỉnh Pampanga
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงพยาบาลอำเภอ Guagua ในเทศบาล Guagua, จังหวัด Pampanga เป็นโรงพยาบาลจังหวัด Pampanga
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Rumah Sakit Kabupaten Guagua di Kotamadya Guagua, Provinsi Pampanga menjadi Rumah Sakit Provinsi Pampanga
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Hospital Daerah Guagua di Perbandaran Guagua, Wilayah Pampanga menjadi Hospital Wilayah Pampanga

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1989/ra_6784_1989.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Guagua District Hospital in the Municipality of Guagua, Province of Pampanga, is hereby changed to Pampanga Provincial Hospital.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
